title: MobileLinux OTA Release Manifest
description: Signed metadata describing a release for one device+channel. The client verifies device id, architecture, minimum version, hashes and the signature BEFORE installing. Designed to be hosted on GitHub Releases / static HTTP / object storage; the server never needs access to the phone.

id.description: Device id this release targets. MUST match the client's device or install is refused.

minimum_version.description: Client must be at least this version to accept the update (blocks unsafe skips).

artifacts.description: Per-component artifacts. Each is independently hashed so a client can update only what changed (rootfs vs kernel vs device packages).

url.description: Absolute or relative URL to the artifact (e.g. a GitHub release asset).

security_patch_level.description: Date the userspace/kernel security state corresponds to, e.g. '2026-09-01'.

sbom_url.description: URL to the SBOM (SPDX/CycloneDX) for this release.

fixed_cves.description: CVEs fixed relative to the previous release.

signature.description: Detached signature over the canonical manifest body (all fields except this one). Verified with the release public key shipped on the device.

key_id.description: Identifier of the signing key (for rotation).

value.description: Base64 signature of the manifest body.
